description: This file contains functions for upgrading and checking the platform, specifically dealing with disk partitions and images, in the context of OpenWRT firmware updates. It includes functions to verify partition layouts, perform upgrades, and copy configuration data.

methods.name: mbl_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks the partition layout of the upgrade device against an image to detect changes.

methods.name: mbl_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, writing image data to disk partitions and updating UUIDs.

methods.name: mbl_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a specific partition.
